buyer_question: Has the candidate received the right joining pack and owner due date?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted offer date, joining date, pack sent timestamp, missing-form list
ready_to_act_when: Candidate has acknowledged pack and missing items are categorized by HR/payroll/IT/legal
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not claim faster onboarding or legal compliance from incomplete form counts.

buyer_question: Which documents are blocking payroll or statutory setup?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted checklist of ID/payroll/tax fields with no government IDs or bank details
ready_to_act_when: Owner can confirm status without storing sensitive IDs in the automation tool
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not collect unnecessary personal data or claim tax/legal correctness without adviser review.

buyer_question: Will laptop, email, SSO, apps and role permissions be ready by day one?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted ticket IDs, device status, access-request owner, approval age
ready_to_act_when: Each access request has approver, due date, least-privilege note and revocation owner
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not ask for passwords, OTPs, secrets or admin credentials.

buyer_question: Does the manager know what must happen before first week productivity?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted manager checklist, buddy assignment, training links, day-one agenda
ready_to_act_when: Manager confirms agenda, buddy, first-week work and escalation path
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not promise productivity or retention outcomes from checklist readiness.

buyer_question: Which policy acknowledgements need human/legal owner review?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted policy names, acknowledgement status, version, owner
ready_to_act_when: Current policy version and owner approval source are visible
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not provide legal advice or mark employment-policy compliance as proven.

buyer_question: Are candidate questions stuck in email, WhatsApp, Slack or recruiter notes?
redacted_evidence_to_collect: Redacted question log, channel, last response date, accountable owner
ready_to_act_when: Questions are routed to HR, payroll, IT, manager or adviser with SLA
unsafe_claim_boundary: Do not automate sensitive answers that require HR, legal, payroll or privacy review.
